chunks.text:
Payment Status Change Event > OpenAPI definition #/components/schemas/UAEPaymentAPI.AEPaymentStatus

{
 "type": "string",
 "enum": [
 "Pending",
 "AcceptedSettlementCompleted",
 "AcceptedCreditSettlementCompleted",
 "AcceptedWithoutPosting",
 "Rejected"
 ],
 "description": "Specifies the status of the payment information group\n* Pending: Payment initiation or individual transaction included in the payment initiation is pending. Further checks and status update will be performed.\n* Rejected: The payment initiation has been rejected\n* AcceptedSettlementCompleted: Settlement of the Debtor's account has been completed\n* AcceptedCreditSettlementCompleted: When the Creditor account has been credited with the funds of the payment initiated via the TPP\n* AcceptedWithoutPosting: When the Recipient Bank has accepted the payment but has not applied the credit to the Creditor account yet."
}
